name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5)
publisher: Open-Meteo; ERA5 by ECMWF / Copernicus Climate Change Service
date_basis: Melbourne local year converted from UTC with IANA DST rules.
coverage: Shared FTZ regional proxy; requested -37.8136, 144.9631; ERA5 grid -37.75, 145, 0.25 degrees.
processing: UTC to DST-aware local time; accumulated previous-hour fields moved to their interval start; local-day aggregation; exceptional DST clock hours left blank in crowd join table. Added project-defined OUTDOOR_WALK_V1 good_weather/bad_weather classification; local 09:00–17:00 daily classification uses at least 75% good hours. Underlying ERA5 dataset: https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/datasets/reanalysis-era5-single-levels?tab=overview Saved request: https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=-37.8136&longitude=144.9631&start_date=2024-12-31&end_date=2025-12-31&hourly=temperature_2m%2Capparent_temperature%2Crelative_humidity_2m%2Cdew_point_2m%2Ccloud_cover%2Cprecipitation%2Crain%2Cwind_speed_10m%2Cwind_gusts_10m%2Cwind_direction_10m%2Csunshine_duration%2Cshortwave_radiation%2Cis_day%2Cweather_code&models=era5&timezone=GMT&timeformat=unixtime&temperature_unit=celsius&wind_speed_unit=kmh&precipitation_unit=mm&cell_selection=land
limitations: Regional model reconstruction rather than a CBD station observation. Not street-level microclimate or a live travel forecast. Hourly sampled daily min/max are not continuous-day extrema. Good/bad thresholds are project assumptions for relative outdoor tourism suitability, not health or safety standards. Cloudiness is not a direct exclusion. The weather-code screen is conservative and can retain a wet state at the hour start after preceding-hour rain; no measured street visibility or UV input is available.
licence: CC BY 4.0; https://open-meteo.com/en/licence
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (ERA5, 2025).
